neighbours.label: a possessive (my, our, your, ma) in a context where 'favorite' is the predictable next word, as against possessives followed by ordinary nouns
fire: On rainy evenings I curl up and watch my favorite movie again.
We ate lunch at one of our favorite restaurants by the river.
That song has always been one of my favorite songs from the eighties.
Saturday mornings mean pancakes at our favorite diner downtown.
He finally got to meet his favorite author at the book signing.
Autumn is my favorite season because of the cool air and colors.
Tell us about your favorite book and why you keep rereading it.
Chocolate cake is still my favorite dessert after all these years.
quiet: On rainy evenings I curl up and fold my laundry in the bedroom.
We ate lunch at the table in our kitchen by the window.
That song was playing on my radio when the power went out.
Saturday mornings mean cleaning our garage and the driveway.
He finally got to repair his bicycle after the rain stopped.
Autumn is when my neighbors rake leaves into big piles.
Tell us about your commute and how long it takes each day.
Chocolate stains are still on my shirt after two washes.

predictions: fire 0.3-0.85 on the possessive before 'favorite'; possessives before keys, house, car below 0.15
